patthana15.62:1.1: upekkhāsahagataṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upekkhāsahagato na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na upekkhāsahagataṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na upekkhāsahagato na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi,
patthana15.62:2.1: upekkhāsahagataṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upekkhāsahagato na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na upekkhāsahagataṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na upekkhāsahagato na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi. (abyākatamūlaṃ tīṇimeva.)
